runes.name: Secret alphabet
runes.desc: A message in made-up signs; the key is torn into scraps the party finds along the way

field.phraseHint: What the players will read. Punctuation is dropped automatically.
field.fragmentsTip: How many pieces to tear the key into. Each scrap is a separate part: hand them to different players as the adventure goes.
field.spacesTip: Without spaces the signs run as one line — harder to crack.

status.fewer: only {n} scraps — too few distinct letters

problem.empty: Type a message: it will be written in secret signs.
problem.tooLong: Too long: {letters}, and a sheet holds at most {max}. Shorten the message.

runes.decoys: Decoys — these letters are not in the message: {letters}

preview.all: The answer is under the signs; the colour shows which scrap holds the letter

view.decoyLegend: † — decoy: this letter is not in the message
view.hintFull: Type the letters you guess into the table — they appear under the signs. Gold ones come from key scraps. Click a sign in the message to jump to its cell.
view.hintMessage: You have no key: guess from frequent signs and short words. Click a sign in the message to jump to its cell.
view.hintKey: You only hold a key scrap. The message itself is with someone else.
